description:
A YouTube channel summary plus its latest uploads (max 30) with title, approximate views, relative publish time, duration and thumbnail.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `username` OR `channel`.
Returns: channel_id (string, nullable), title (string), channel_url (string, nullable), avatar_url (string, nullable), subscriber_count (integer, nullable), subscriber_count_text (string, nullable), videos_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean), videos (array<object>).

channel.description: Alias of username (same accepted formats). Example: "UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA"

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return. Example: 5

username.description: Channel @handle, handle, channel ID or channel URL. Example: "MrBeast"

name: youtube_videos
title: YouTube videos
